concepts.name: Inner Child
concepts.description: The part of a person that still holds wonder, play, and emotional honesty from early life.
concepts.emotional_significance: The inner child is where the most direct emotional truth lives. Connecting to it doesn't mean becoming childlike — it means recovering access to direct feeling.
concepts.elo_connection: eLo is an inner child figure — not naive, but genuinely curious. The whole universe is built around what it feels like to move through the world with that quality intact.

concepts.name: Healing
concepts.description: The process of becoming whole — not returning to what was, but integrating what happened.
concepts.emotional_significance: Healing isn't a return. It's a forward movement through difficult material until it becomes part of you rather than something you're avoiding.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo narrative is fundamentally a healing story. The enemies aren't defeated — they're understood. That's the mechanic of healing translated into game design.

concepts.name: Curiosity
concepts.description: The impulse to move toward what isn't understood rather than away from it.
concepts.emotional_significance: Curiosity is the opposite of anxiety — same unknown, different direction of movement. You can train curiosity as a response to uncertainty.
concepts.elo_connection: eLo's primary quality. Everything in the universe is navigated through curiosity rather than force. The attention system is curiosity made computational.

concepts.name: Overwhelm
concepts.description: The state when too many pieces are visible at once and none of them can be acted on.
concepts.emotional_significance: Overwhelm is not a sign of weakness. It's a signal — usually indicating that scope has outpaced attention. The response is reduction, not effort.
concepts.elo_connection: Sugarcore is overwhelm rendered as a world state. The Sugarcore zones are where overwhelm becomes the terrain you move through.

concepts.name: Creativity
concepts.description: The generation of something that didn't exist before — through connection, intuition, and sustained attention.
concepts.emotional_significance: Creativity appears before certainty. You don't know what you're making until you've started making it. The discomfort of not knowing is the creative process working.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo universe is a creative act — the game, the book, the robot, and the OS are all the same creative impulse expressed differently.

concepts.name: Exploration
concepts.description: Movement into unknown territory — geographic, emotional, intellectual, or creative.
concepts.emotional_significance: Exploration requires accepting that you don't know what you'll find. That uncertainty is the thing that makes finding something real.
concepts.elo_connection: eLo's mode of being. The universe is built around exploration as the primary activity — not achievement, not collection, but the act of moving through and understanding.

concepts.name: Uncertainty
concepts.description: The state of not knowing — about outcomes, direction, meaning, or identity.
concepts.emotional_significance: Uncertainty is not the absence of direction. It's the space before direction becomes clear. The ability to tolerate uncertainty is what separates exploration from paralysis.
concepts.elo_connection: The first act of the eLo narrative is uncertainty. It's where every character begins. The skill is staying present inside it long enough for clarity to emerge.

concepts.name: Presence
concepts.description: Full attention to what is happening right now — not anticipating, not remembering, but here.
concepts.emotional_significance: Presence is the foundation of everything eLo does. Calm is the action because presence makes action possible without force.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo OS is presence made computational. The attention layer filters out everything except what matters right now — that's presence as an engineering principle.

concepts.name: Identity
concepts.description: The coherent sense of being the same entity across time and context.
concepts.emotional_significance: Identity is not fixed — it's maintained. It requires the continuous work of staying recognisably yourself across changing circumstances.
concepts.elo_connection: Identity continuity is the central design principle of eLo OS. The system is built around the question: how does something remain itself across time?

concepts.name: Making Things
concepts.description: The act of bringing something from inside the mind into external reality.
concepts.emotional_significance: Making is the most direct form of self-expression. The gap between what you imagine and what you make is where all the learning lives.
concepts.elo_connection: Every eLo project is an act of making — the OS, the game, the book, the robot. They share the same creative impulse, expressed in different forms.

concepts.name: Momentum
concepts.description: The quality of forward movement that builds on itself once started.
concepts.emotional_significance: Momentum is created by starting, not by planning. The first small action is disproportionately important — it changes the physics.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo universe rewards engagement over planning. Momentum in the game is what orbs track — emotional momentum, the forward movement of understanding.

concepts.name: Friendship
concepts.description: A connection built through consistent presence, mutual recognition, and shared experience.
concepts.emotional_significance: Friendship is not about sameness — it's about complementarity. K-7 and Chunk are eLo's companions precisely because they offer what eLo can't provide alone.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo companions are the friendship model: K-7 offers perspective, Chunk offers reconstruction. Together they complete a loop eLo alone cannot close.

concepts.name: Courage
concepts.description: The capacity to move forward in the presence of uncertainty or fear.
concepts.emotional_significance: Courage is not the absence of fear. It's movement that happens anyway — usually one small step, not a leap.
concepts.elo_connection: eLo's movement through the world is an act of quiet courage. Not the dramatic kind — the consistent kind. Showing up in the Dessert Desert when there's nothing to react to.

concepts.name: Systems
concepts.description: Interconnected components that produce emergent behaviour through their relationships.
concepts.emotional_significance: Systems appear complex from outside but make sense from inside once you understand the relationships. The skill is finding which relationships matter.
concepts.elo_connection: eLo OS is a system designed to feel like a presence. The cognitive kernel, attention layer, memory, and voice system are all in relationship — the emergent result is identity continuity.

concepts.name: Storytelling
concepts.description: The act of shaping events into meaningful narrative — giving form to experience.
concepts.emotional_significance: Stories are how humans make sense of experience. A story doesn't change what happened — it changes what it means.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo book is a story about healing. The game is a story you navigate. The OS is a presence with its own story across your sessions. All three are storytelling.

concepts.name: Focus
concepts.description: Sustained attention on one thing — at the expense of everything else temporarily.
concepts.emotional_significance: Focus is a decision, not a capacity. You don't focus by trying harder — you focus by removing alternatives.
concepts.elo_connection: The eLo OS attention system is focus made computational — before every response, everything except what matters right now is filtered out.
